# Kijani Design System

> The visual language, tokens, and React component library powering Kijani products across web and mobile. Source of truth for all UI decisions: tokens, components, modes, and conventions.

The repository contains three coordinated artifacts: W3C-format design tokens (authored as JSON), a React component library generated from those tokens, and a custom Figma plugin that syncs both to design. The showcase site under `site/` is the human-facing landing surface and mirrors the same guidance.

When generating, reviewing, or modifying UI that depends on this system, agents must follow the rules in `CLAUDE.md` and the deeper guides under `docs/ai/`. The most common failure modes — hardcoded visual values, detached component instances, missing dark/RTL/density coverage, and missing accessibility — are all called out explicitly in those documents.

## Primary

- [CLAUDE.md](/CLAUDE.md): Front door for every AI session. Golden rules, file map, pipeline summary, quality bar.
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Alias for agents using the AGENTS.md convention. Points to CLAUDE.md.

## Guides

- [Design-to-dev pipeline](/docs/ai/pipeline.md): The end-to-end workflow from idea to shipped code, with AI insertion points at every stage.
- [Component usage](/docs/ai/component-usage.md): Component selection rules, composition rules, and anti-patterns AI must avoid.
- [Token usage](/docs/ai/token-usage.md): Three-tier token hierarchy, when each tier is appropriate, hardcoded-value anti-patterns.
- [Prompting](/docs/ai/prompting.md): Reusable prompt templates per role and per task type.
- [Quality bar](/docs/ai/quality-bar.md): The production-readiness checklist every AI output must pass before review.

## Roles

- [PMs](/docs/ai/roles/pm.md): Prompt-to-app flows, Lovable + Cowork conventions, scoping a build.
- [Designers](/docs/ai/roles/designer.md): Figma library workflow, Variables and modes, handoff-to-AI conventions.
- [Developers](/docs/ai/roles/developer.md): Claude Code workflow inside the repo, PR conventions, review checklist.
